span.p:
lruLink packs prev+next as
(prev<<0)|(next<<16)
halving cache-line cost
vs separate prev/next arrays

span.p:
bump-pointer allocator:
Put(s) copies into active slab,
returns packed uint64 id.
Get(id) = zero alloc.
Keeps GC off per-key path.
